The ELF header

The macro is 16, so is 16 bytes. The first 4

The 5th byte is called : a 32-bit program ( =

The 6th byte indicates the integer format ( ). The one we want

The 7th byte is the ELF version ( ), always 1 as of this
writing.
The 8th byte is the ABI ( ), which in this case is (0).
The 9th byte is the version ( ), which is just 0 again.
The rest is zero padding.
